column1: # Reference files read by Stages 2-3 (data/references/biomart/), as on disk for the v2 build.
# Ensembl 115 / GRCr8 BioMart exports (fetched 2026-02-24; byte-identical to the sep2025.archive.ensembl.org
# archive) plus RGD GENES_RAT.txt, whose header reads '# GENERATED-ON: 2026/02/21' (RGD serves only the
# current release, so this file cannot be re-downloaded: it is deposited with the v2 data).
# lib/gene_utils.verify_reference_md5s() checks files against this table; Stage 2 step 1 fails on a
# mismatch unless --allow-reference-drift (or biomart.allow_reference_drift: true) is given.
